json_ld.description:
A soft waffle-knit hoodie sweater is just the right call when it's breezy outside. It has the cozy feel of a slub-textured sweatshirt with the clean, put-together look of a sweater, so it works just as well thrown over a tee as it does holding its own.

The adjustable hood is there when you need it, and the waffle texture keeps it from ever feeling bulky. Throw one on over a tee or Henley and pair it with our Classic Chino Pants for an easygoing autumn look.
